name: Is it better to paint walls before or after installing baseboards and trim?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to paint walls before or after installing baseboards and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing trim before painting the walls or after depends on the project scope, but pre-finishing trim before installation offers practical advantages. Professional contractors frequently apply primer and a primary coat of paint to trim boards while they are still on sawhorses. Once nailed into place, carpenters caulk the seams, fill nail holes, and apply a final topcoat to blend everything smoothly. This sequence prevents overspray or roller marks on freshly finished trim while cutting down on tedious edging along the wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting walls first and pre-coating trim boards on sawhorses is best; final caulking and finish touch-ups occur after trim is nailed into place.
